title: Hopeless
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: Sky has been home-schooled and has never had a boyfriend, until she meets Dean Holder at college. He seems to know something about her and gives her a reason to question the life she has led.
readIf: you want an intense, emotional new adult romance with a mystery that unfolds slowly.
skipIf: stories involving childhood sexual abuse are off the table for you.

pairings.reason: A tender teen romance that also deals with a difficult home life.
A young adult novel about trauma and silence, more serious and without the romance focus.
Another Hoover novel that mixes a love story with a painful subject.
